events.title: Slay the Q Devlog #10
events.summary: Hello and welcome to another dev update for Slay the Q!Work on the game is still ongoing. This time it's new backgrounds. The one we have is nice, but can get boring, so the aim is to add new ones for some variety. Since these are big pieces, the progress is a bit slow, but steady. Hopefully We will have one to show next time!If you have any feedback about the game, don’t hesitate to use the Feedback button available in the game!

events.title: Slay the Q Devlog #9
events.summary: Hello and welcome to another dev update for Slay the Q!After all the previous new content additions, this time we have a round of smaller improvements. All the new encounters and cards can now be unlocked, with a popup showing you what you just got. New deck unlocks are included in this as well.I have added a few small UI updates. events.title: Slay the Q Devlog #8
events.summary: Hello and welcome to another dev update for Slay the Q!New content continues. As mentioned in the last update, the game needed a few dozen new artifacts to fill out loot tables for new encounters. I wasn't able to create as many as I would like, but there are still over 40 new items added to the game.In addition, while filling out encounters with new rewards, a bunch of taunts have been added where there were none. events.title: Slay the Q Devlog #7
events.summary: Hello and welcome to another dev update for Slay the Q!I've been busy with new content. New cards were used to create dozens of encounters, each with unique deck and loot. Actually, I needed so much loot for them that I ran out of artifacts. To resolve this I decided to add a few dozen more to the game. events.title: Slay the Q Devlog #6
events.summary: Hello and welcome to another dev update for Slay the Q!Another two weeks, another demo update. This time changes are mostly cosmetic, but it's still worth trying out!A four legendary encounters were added to the demo version, as it felt lacking without them. Rare ones that were used instead were not interesting enough. They should present nicely combined with the upcoming boss feature.There were smaller visual updates. Buttons have a new design and should combine better with the rest of the UI.

events.summary: Hello and welcome to another dev update for Slay the Q!New demo update is here! It finally brings the new Party mechanic, as well as few other changes.From now on, summon cards that are played have to form one of the pre-defined party compositions.These compositions, and their bonuses, can be seen in a new info panel avialable via new star button.When cards are selected, the best party they can form will be shown above the battlefield. events.title: Slay the Q Devlog #4
events.summary: Hello and welcome to another dev update for Slay the Q!Development of the new Parties mechanic is nearly done. Mechanic itself is ready, together with new UI and new upgrade cards. It will be added to the demo version of the game once the Tutorial is updated to cover new game rules.There is also new set of capsules for Steam page of the game. I hope you'll like them once they are applied.If you have any feedback about the game, don’t hesitate to use the Feedback button available in the game!

events.title: Slay the Q Devlog #3
events.summary: Hello and welcome to another dev update for Slay the Q!I've been hard at work adding new mechanic to the game that should give gameplay more depth, and encourage discarding. Until now, there is hardly much need to use the discard mechanic, as you mostly get decent mix of cards straight away. It also makes stacking same tier and same element bonuses very powerful.
